fields.name: Phlebotomy Start Date/Time
fields.condition: messageCode = DPR AND DON-12 in (NIN, ABR) OR messageCode = DPR AND DON-21 in (SUC, UL5)
fields.optionalityCitation: v2.9 CH04 section 4.17.1: the attribute table (pp173-174) prints R, but DON-1 and DON-2 are 'mandatory except when using an eligibility message type in which only DON-9, DON-10, and DON-11 are populated' (pp174-175), so outside a donation a DON carrying DON-9 to DON-11 alone is compliant; required on DPR (4.16.15 p172), the one message sure to be a donation. DON-3 (p175), 'The start date and time of the phlebotomy', presumes the needle went in, so a DPR needs it when DON-12 (p176) is NIN or ABR, not interrupted or interrupted 'after the Phlebotomist inserts the needle' (Table 0923, CH02C p629, technical correction), or DON-21 (p179) is SUC or UL5, blood drawn (Table 0926, CH02C p632, technical correction). A walk-out (WOT), NDR 'Not Drawn' or a site code shows no needle. Modelled C (P4-30).

fields.name: Process Interruption Reason

fields.optionalityCitation: v2.9 CH04 section 4.17.1: the attribute table (pp173-174) prints R, but DON-1 and DON-2 are 'mandatory except when using an eligibility message type in which only DON-9, DON-10, and DON-11 are populated' (pp174-175), so outside a donation a DON carrying DON-9 to DON-11 alone is compliant; required on DPR (4.16.15 p172), the one message sure to be a donation. fields.name: Phlebotomy Issue

fields.optionalityCitation: v2.9 CH04 section 4.17.1: the attribute table (pp173-174) prints R, but DON-1 and DON-2 are 'mandatory except when using an eligibility message type in which only DON-9, DON-10, and DON-11 are populated' (pp174-175), so outside a donation a DON carrying DON-9 to DON-11 alone is compliant; required on DPR (4.16.15 p172), the one message sure to be a donation. DON-14 (p177) 'Indicates whether there is a problem or issue with the phlebotomy itself', and Table 0925 (CH02C pp630-631, technical correction) has no code for none, so a DPR needs it when DON-13 is DNI, 'Phlebotomy Issue' (Table 0935, CH02C p637, technical correction). Modelled C (P4-30).

fields.name: Intended Recipient Blood Relative
fields.optionalityCitation: v2.9 CH04 section 4.17.1: the attribute table (pp173-174) prints R, but DON-1 and DON-2 are 'mandatory except when using an eligibility message type in which only DON-9, DON-10, and DON-11 are populated' (pp174-175), so outside a donation a DON carrying DON-9 to DON-11 alone is compliant; required on DPR (4.16.15 p172), the one message sure to be a donation. DON-15 (p177) applies 'If this donation has an intended recipient (directed, dedicated, designated)'. No printed field shows such a recipient: DON-2 takes ISBT 128's codes, and DON-16 to DON-20 cover an autologous recipient too. So it is never required, and the leg is not checked. Modelled C (P4-30).
